title: Get started with detqc
text: filter_duplicates() removes repeated detections one transmitter one receiver one time. filter_post_release() removes first 6 h release, animals recover tagging. filter_min_lag() removes false detections, isolated time: detection detection transmitter receiver within threshold. Following Pincock (2012), threshold 30 times average delay tags, 4,500 s . Isolated detections draws lags study . filter_min_lag() removes isolated detections logs .
code: # Remove repeated detections of one transmitter on one receiver dets <- filter_duplicates(dets) # Remove the first 6 h of each animal's record, its recovery from tagging dets <- filter_post_release(dets, hours = 6) # Set the threshold: 30 times the average delay, the mean of each tag's # minimum and maximum delay from the tag sheet max_lag <- 30 * mean((animals$min_delay + animals$max_delay) / 2) max_lag #> [1] 4500 # Remove detections isolated in time beyond the threshold, or alone dets <- filter_min_lag(dets, max_lag_s = max_lag) # Print the log so far: detections before and after each step detset_log(dets)[, c("step", "rows_before", "rows_after", "removed")] #>                  step rows_before rows_after removed #> 1              detset        3297       3297       0 #> 2   calibrate_sensors        3297       3297       0 #> 3        check_detset        3297       3297       0 #> 4     audit_listening        3297       3297       0 #> 5   filter_duplicates        3297       3297       0 #> 6 filter_post_release        3297       3191     106 #> 7      filter_min_lag        3191       3148      43

text: mortality_rule() adds evidence stream. one reads calibrated depth readings votes dead last 48 hours animal’s readings vary less 0.1 m. kind = "evidence", , shows cards beside streams never decides band; stream made kind = "vote" decides. ?mortality_rule lists tables stream receives. code: # Define a stream: dead when the last 48 h of depth vary by under 0.1 m depth_still <- mortality_rule("depth_still", function(data, settings) {   # Keep the depth readings; last_hours() keeps an animal's last hours   depth_readings <- data$readings[data$readings$class == "depth", ]   last_hours <- function(readings) {     readings[readings$datetime >= max(readings$datetime) -                settings$hours * 3600, ]   }   # Vote once per animal from the spread of its last hours of depth   vote_one <- function(animal_readings) {     sd_m <- stats::sd(last_hours(animal_readings)$value)     data.frame(animal_id = animal_readings$animal_id[1],                vote = if (sd_m < settings$sd_m) "dead" else "none",                detail = sprintf("depth SD %.2f m over the last %d h", sd_m,                                 settings$hours))   }   votes <- lapply(split(depth_readings, depth_readings$animal_id), vote_one)   do.call(rbind, votes) }, kind = "evidence", settings = list(hours = 48, sd_m = 0.1), label = "depth still") # Add the stream to the rule set and band the animals again mort_rules$depth_still <- depth_still bands <- detect_mortality(dets, rules = mort_rules) bands$bands[, c("animal_id", "band", "depth_still_vote")] #>   animal_id   band depth_still_vote #> 1     ST-02   dead             dead #> 2     ST-01 review      unavailable #> 3     ST-03 review             none #> 4     ST-04 review      unavailable

code: # Read the depth raster: 100 m cells, UTM zone 17N, depth stored as # zero or negative metres, land NA lake <- terra::rast(in_file("stoney_depth.tif")) # Read the tagging records joined to the Stoney tag sheet animals <- read_animals(in_file("stoney_detections.csv"), format = "glatos",                         tag_specs = stoney_specs) # Use the GLATOS export read above detections <- whole # Swap the latitude and longitude of S010 in a copy of the deployments deployments_swapped <- deployments s010 <- deployments_swapped$station_id == "S010" deployments_swapped[s010, c("deploy_lat", "deploy_lon")] <-   deployments[s010, c("deploy_lon", "deploy_lat")] # Project the receivers to the raster's UTM grid to measure distances lonlat <- as.matrix(deployments[, c("deploy_lon", "deploy_lat")]) utm <- terra::project(lonlat, from = "EPSG:4326", to = terra::crs(lake)) stations <- data.frame(station_id = deployments$station_id, x = utm[, 1],                        y = utm[, 2]) # Pick a true detection, and the station farthest from its own true_row <- detections[detections$animal_id == "ST-01", ][100, ] at_true <- stations$station_id == true_row$station_id far <- stations[which.max((stations$x - stations$x[at_true])^2 +                             (stations$y - stations$y[at_true])^2), ] # Make the false detection: same transmitter, far station, 2 min later false_row <- true_row false_row$datetime <- true_row$datetime + 120 false_row$station_id <- far$station_id far_dep <- deployments$station_id == far$station_id false_row$receiver_serial <- deployments$receiver_serial[far_dep] false_row[, c("datetime", "receiver_serial", "station_id")] #>                datetime receiver_serial station_id #> 377 2024-06-03 14:38:04            R020       S020 # Add the false detection to the detections detections <- rbind(detections, false_row) # Leave ST-03's detections out of a copy of the detections detections_planted <- detections[detections$animal_id != "ST-03", ] # Write ST-04's first 25 detections with a wrong code space st04_first <- which(detections_planted$animal_id == "ST-04")[1:25] detections_planted$transmitter[st04_first] <- "A69-1303-61004" detections_planted$animal_id[st04_first] <- NA # Count detections by transmitter in the copy table(detections_planted$transmitter) #>  #> A69-1303-61004 A69-1601-61001 A69-1601-61004 A69-9002-61002  #>             25            847            690           1273 # Build a detection set of the planted copies and check it dets <- check_detset(detset(detections_planted, deployments_swapped, animals),                      water = abs(lake), field = 1500) # Print the checks that flagged check_summary <- dets$checks$summary check_summary[check_summary$status == "flag",               c("check", "flagged", "of", "unit")] #>                    check flagged of         unit #> 2        swapped_lat_lon       1 20  deployments #> 15       receiver_silent       5 20  deployments #> 17 transmitter_no_animal       1  4 transmitters #> 18    animal_never_heard       1  4      animals # Show the swapped station, with the position the check suggests dets$checks$rows$swapped_lat_lon[, c("station_id", "deploy_lat", "deploy_lon",                                      "suggested_lat", "suggested_lon")] #>   station_id deploy_lat deploy_lon suggested_lat suggested_lon #> 1       S010  -78.13148   44.54843      44.54843     -78.13148 # List the transmitters heard that no animal carries, most heard first dets$checks$rows$transmitter_no_animal[, c("transmitter", "detections",                                            "receivers")] #>      transmitter detections receivers #> 1 A69-1303-61004         25         2 # List the animals of the tagging records with no detection dets$checks$rows$animal_never_heard #>   animal_id   transmitters #> 1     ST-03 A69-9002-61003 # Rebuild the set with the correct deployments and the full detections dets <- check_detset(detset(detections, deployments, animals),                      water = abs(lake), field = 1500) # Print the checks that still flag check_summary <- dets$checks$summary check_summary[check_summary$status == "flag",               c("check", "flagged", "of", "unit")] #>              check flagged of        unit #> 15 receiver_silent       5 20 deployments # Map the receivers over the lake depth, sized by their detections receiver_map <- plot_receivers(dets, water = lake) # Take the positions of the station that heard ST-01 and of the false # detection's station jump_ends <- receiver_map$data[match(c(true_row$station_id, far$station_id),                                      receiver_map$data$station_id), ] # The rings cannot show the jump the filter acts on, so a keyed line draws it jump <- data.frame(x = jump_ends$deploy_lon[1], y = jump_ends$deploy_lat[1],                    xend = jump_ends$deploy_lon[2], yend = jump_ends$deploy_lat[2]) receiver_map +   ggplot2::geom_segment(data = jump,                         ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend,                                      linetype = "Jump to the false detection"),                         inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "red3", linewidth = 0.8) +   ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(name = NULL,                                  values = c("Jump to the false detection" = 2)) +   # code: # Fit the range test's d05: a logistic curve of the share heard on distance range_test <- read.csv(in_file("stoney_range_test.csv")) test_depth <- range_test$deploy_z[1] range_fit <- glm(cbind(detections, transmissions - detections) ~ distance_m,                  family = binomial, data = range_test) d05_test <- (qlogis(0.05) - coef(range_fit)[[1]]) / coef(range_fit)[[2]] # Read d05 linearly from the test depth to the deepest receiver, towards # the deep end of the positionR range model of Stoney Lake (1,500 m at # 35 m), as detfield::de_logistic() reads it. deep_d05 <- 1500 deep_depth <- 35 d05_deepest_exact <- approx(c(test_depth, deep_depth), c(d05_test, deep_d05),                             xout = max(deployments$deploy_z))$y # Round it to the nearest 100 m d05_deepest <- round(d05_deepest_exact, -2) # Print the test depth, its d05, the deepest receiver and its d05 round(c(test_depth_m = test_depth, d05_test_m = d05_test,         deepest_receiver_m = max(deployments$deploy_z),         d05_deepest_m = d05_deepest_exact, d05_deepest_rounded_m = d05_deepest), 2) #>          test_depth_m            d05_test_m    deepest_receiver_m  #>                  1.00                492.29                 24.83  #>         d05_deepest_m d05_deepest_rounded_m  #>               1198.58               1200.00 # Set the highest speed accepted, 2 m/s, and the largest distance at which # two receivers hear one transmission, 2,500 m max_speed <- 2 min_dist <- 2500 # List each step between consecutive detections of one animal, and its speed steps <- speed_steps(dets, max_speed_ms = max_speed, min_dist_m = min_dist) nrow(steps) #> [1] 3294 # Keep the steps between two different stations moves <- steps[steps$dist_m > 0, ] nrow(moves) #> [1] 157 # Show the steps farther than min_dist and faster than max_speed moves[moves$violation, c("animal_id", "datetime", "dist_m", "speed_ms")] #>     animal_id            datetime   dist_m speed_ms #> 100     ST-01 2024-06-03 14:38:04 9218.351 76.81959 #> 101     ST-01 2024-06-03 14:40:55 9218.351 53.90849 # Mark the two steps into and out of the planted detection planted <- moves$animal_id == "ST-01" &   (moves$datetime == false_row$datetime | moves$from == false_row$datetime) # The axis labels the powers of ten from 0.001 to 1,000 m/s that fall inside # the plotted range ticks <- 10^(-3:3) steps_lab <- "Step into or out of the planted detection" mark_col <- stats::setNames(c("#31688E", "#D55E00"), c("Step", steps_lab)) mark_shape <- stats::setNames(c(1, 17), c("Step", steps_lab)) corner <- data.frame(xmin = min_dist, xmax = Inf, ymin = max_speed, ymax = Inf) ggplot2::ggplot(moves, ggplot2::aes(dist_m, speed_ms)) +   ggplot2::geom_rect(data = corner, ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,                                                  ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,                                                  fill = "Where the filter acts"),                      inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.2) +   ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = max_speed, linetype = 2) +   ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = min_dist, linetype = 2) +   ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(colour = "Step", shape = "Step")) +   ggplot2::geom_point(data = moves[planted, ],                       ggplot2::aes(colour = steps_lab, shape = steps_lab),                       size = 2.5) +   ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Where the filter acts" = "#E69F00")) +   ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = mark_col) +   ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = mark_shape) +   ggplot2::scale_y_log10(breaks = ticks,                          labels = format(ticks, scientific = FALSE,                                          drop0trailing = TRUE)) +   ggplot2::expand_limits(x = 0) +   ggplot2::labs(x = "Distance between stations (m)",                 y = "Speed of the step (m/s)") +   theme_positionr() +   ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom") # code: # Stoney Lake, Ontario (100 m cells, depth in metres, zero or negative, land # NA). detfield and detqc each ship a copy of the raster; terra reads it. if (requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {   tif <- system.file("extdata", "stoney_depth.tif", package = "detfield")   if (!nzchar(tif)) {     tif <- system.file("extdata", "stoney_depth.tif", package = "detqc")   }   lake <- terra::as.data.frame(abs(terra::rast(tif)), xy = TRUE)   names(lake)[3] <- "depth"   # Detection probability of one transmission from each cell for a receiver   # in the deepest cell, on a logistic curve with d50 600 m and d05 1,200 m,   # by straight-line distance.   rx <- lake[which.max(lake$depth), c("x", "y")]   d <- sqrt((lake$x - rx$x)^2 + (lake$y - rx$y)^2)   lake$p <- stats::plogis(stats::qlogis(0.05) * (d - 600) / 600)   ggplot2::ggplot(lake, ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = p)) +     ggplot2::geom_raster() +     scale_fill_probability() +     ggplot2::coord_equal() +     ggplot2::labs(x = "Easting (m, UTM 17N)", y = "Northing (m, UTM 17N)") +     annotation_scale_bar(location = "br") +     theme_positionr() }
